findings: Donald Cameron plant, Arthur Haines nodes and Glen Mittelhauser stems: straight jointed green stems, many unbranched and some sparse ascending branch whorls. Old dense generic whorls rejected. Current three-size pilots (seeds 1,4,7) and every panel of36-seed contact sheet visually reviewed. Sparse ascending whorls and many unbranched straight shoots replace dense generic whorls; 42–88 cm. Node sheaths below pitch. Low colony connectors require soil embedding. Accepted as stylized spring source; variant endorsement remains a user decision.
